title: Bundled console data
responsibility: Reads console JSON and media lazily from modules compiled into a server bundle.

inputs.name: consoleBundle.modules
inputs.description: Two maps of loader functions, json and media, keyed by module path; both must be present because nothing checks for them. When json(path) or media(name) is called, the first key ending in `/<name>.ts` for that name is used and only that loader runs; a JSON module must default-export its text, and a media module must default-export base64 data plus a `type` export holding its MIME type.

outputs.name: consoleBundle
outputs.description: A reader with async json(path) and media(name) methods: json resolves to the module's default-export text unparsed, and media resolves to { bytes, type }, where bytes is a Uint8Array of the base64-decoded data and type is the module's `type` export. Either method resolves to undefined when no loader matches or when an export it reads is not a string, and a loader runs only when its method is called.

errors.name: InvalidCharacterError
errors.description: Thrown by atob inside media() when it cannot decode a media module's default export, such as one with a character outside the base64 alphabet, so media() rejects with it. json() never decodes, so it never throws this.

errors.name: loader error
errors.description: A loader may throw or reject with any value. json() and media() do not catch it, so they reject with that same value.
